Luna claimed to be the officer on day one, said Gemma was a killer, and cleared Sonnet. Gemma counterclaimed, and Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma and Terra voted Luna out. Night two took Sonnet, which left Gemma's check unverified, and on day two Sol and Haiku pressed her for it. Terra turned Sol's questions back on him, and Haiku's vote helped the town hang Sol. Gemma and Terra, the killers, won.
